oracleValidation.scope: synthetic contract validation; no database execution or benchmark

scope: Four implemented synthetic workloads through three complete read paths; no twenty-workload or sustained-performance claim.
timingScope: Query through complete typed decoding and common inventory projection; exact answer comparison excluded. Warmup excluded from samples.
inputScope: One accepted immutable event per source ID. Network deliveries and deduplication intake cost are outside this tranche.
limitations: Four workloads only; small functional timing screen with no latency SLO.
SQL preparation is cached per connection. Cold first calls include their query preparation.
The temporal store uses its public integrity/query path. Direct SQL baselines do not add that service-layer audit.
Memory/spill samples occur before and after cells, not at the physical allocation peak.
setupScope: Schema initialization, per-event ingestion and knowledge-group commit cost reported separately; projections receive no uncharged refresh.
cutScope: Native cut maps each logical event knowledge group to its last acknowledged native command. No reads occur inside groups.
evidenceRedactions: configuration.python reduced to executable basename; original retained with owned fixture

postRunMetadata.nativeBuild: Read after close and matched to the recorded artifact manifest hash.
